why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P2 shell-1.2 and shell-1.4, P3 shell-1.6): three places where the page kit made the app write its own part. `PageAside` `state` takes only `ControlHandle<boolean>`, so an inspector keyed by a record id derives a boolean handle (`apps/playground/src/cycle/shell-1/handle-adapters.ts:55-74`, 20 lines, two casts). An inspector's body is a key-value list and the kit has none, so the page hand-builds a `dl` grid (`ServicesPage.tsx:96-105`). A field handle has labelled `options` but no lookup for the current value's label (`fleet-store.ts:29-35`).
what: `PageAside` binds a record-id field, the kit ships a key-value list, a handle names its value.
owns: the export-surface and budget files the new symbol needs (shared_append_only)
change: `PageAside` `state` also takes a string field: open while it holds a value, a close clears it. `Facts` in `basalt-ui/page` draws a labelled `dl` of `{ label, value }` rows, two columns from the `regular` container tier and one below, and `page-aside.md` names it for an inspector body. A field handle gets `label(value)`, the label its `.labels()` declared, else the value. The new export names its consumer: the cycle build's inspector (shell-1.4). The PR names the `cycle-shell-1:` workarounds each change makes removable.
proof: make check; unit tests for each change.
acceptance: `<PageAside state={store.field.record}>` with a string field opens while the field is set and clears it on close (test)
`Facts` renders a `dl` with one row per entry, one column in a narrow container (layout test)
out_of_scope: The compact sheet (v3-shell-1-phone-aside); the table's detail host (v3-shell-1-detail-host).
